versions.changelog: Add the energy and power capabilities, H110 hub support, snapshot links via TAPO_MCP_PUBLIC_URL, the 12-capability limit on control_device, TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL, and troubleshooting for the discovery and device errors; requires Tapo MCP v0.6.0 or later.
Documents H200 and H500 camera hub support: their paired sensors are listed as children, like on the H100. Requires tapo-mcp v0.5.1.

Document the restored DNS-rebinding protection: the server now requires TAPO_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS for LAN/hostname access and bearer auth on non-loopback binds, with added 403 Forbidden troubleshooting. Minimum server pinned to v0.5.0.

Replaced quoted credential placeholders in setup docs with bracketed templates (<YOUR_TAPO_PASSWORD>, <YOUR_TAPO_MCP_API_KEY>, etc.) to avoid false-positive ClawScan 'exposed secret literal' findings. No functional changes.
Adds H100 hub and child sensor support (KE100, S200B/D, S210, T100/T110/T300/T31X) with TriggerLogs and TemperatureHumidityRecords capabilities.
Add take_snapshot tool for Tapo cameras, switch invocation to npx mcporter, and pin the skill to Tapo MCP server v0.3.0+.
Added get_device_state tool, Brightness and Color set capabilities. Renamed set_device_state to control_device with multi-capability support. Added Recreate strategy to Kubernetes example.
